config.py.changes: Import relocation; PPO simulator-specific collector omitted, env state annotation generalized.

gce.py.changes: Import relocation; PPO simulator-specific collector omitted, env state annotation generalized. The matrix estimator (LatentGCENetwork, create_gce_train_state, prediction_errors, make_gce_train_step, capacity_from_observations) is omitted because no recipe uses it; the vector estimator keeps the water filling.

vim.py.changes: FixedUniformSourceValue (method vim_uniform) removed because no recipe uses it. Import relocation and target-width initialization; autoregressive likelihood and sampling use parameter-broadcast Flax scans instead of unrolled Python loops. Parameter, output, gradient and RNG parity: tests/test_gce_vim_scans.py.

replay.py.changes: Import relocation and target-width allocation; replay passes use a JAX scan with unchanged key splitting, update cadence and final-pass metrics. Parity: tests/test_gce_vim_scans.py.

ppo.py.changes: Import relocation and generic controller state. Deviations: tanh-squashed controller, stored pre-tanh actions with stable Jacobian-corrected log densities, fresh reparameterized squashed entropy in PPO, and matching evaluation; continuing-objective GAE bootstraps timeouts from final pre-reset observations, cuts traces at every reset, and uses zero bootstrap for true termination. Controller state also checkpoints training coverage grids and episode start positions for ablation-matched exploration metrics. Estimator/probe semantics unchanged. Numeric regressions: tests/test_gce_vim_squashed_ppo.py and tests/test_gce_vim_timeout_exploration.py.
